title: Zindaan Me Gunjti Thi Sakina ki Fugaa
body:
Zindaan main goonjti thi Sakina ki ye fuga faryaad ammu jaan, aate nahin hain lene kokyon humko baba jaan faryaad ammu jaan
Ammu tumhare baad qayamat guzar gayi khaime jale sabhi, mare tamache shumr ne cheeni hai baliya faryaad ammu jaan
Shumr-e-layee ne cheen liye kanoo se gouhar kisko karo khabar, sunta nahi hain koi bhi ab meri siskiyaan faryaad ammu jaan
Jab shumr leke aata tha durra wo kehti thi faryaad ya Ali, waqt-e-madad hain aaiye mushkil kusha yaha faryaad ammu jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Bacchi ke bain sun ke haram kar rahe hai bain hota hain shor-o-shaien, jab dard hota kaan main kehti thi al amaan faryaad ammujaan
Ammu tamache khane ki himmat nahin hai ab hota hai dard ab, aisa mila yateemi ka pursa hume yahan faryaad ammu jaan
Baba ke sar pa sar ko rakha aur margayi beti wo shah ki, aaye moosavi fazaon main baqi hain ye fuga faryaad ammu jaan
